positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
QA Technical Lead
- Lab Manager: 
-- Built high availability lab from ground up to support development and QA efforts. Sourced, purchased, installed and configured servers, switches and other supporting infrastructure hardware and software.
-- Planned design of new lab and led electrical, wiring, HVAC and construction team to build and move lab with minimal downtime and little impact to daily business. 

- QA Technical Lead for CMS/SMS:
-- Designed and executed performance testing to support and triage customer deployments. Completed stress testing and load testing on Linux server cluster and Oracle RAC to measure product scalability and to determine the application’s ability to function under load conditions.
-- QA test lead for 3 releases. Directed team of contractors to create automated test suites for APIs and CMS/gateway interactions and maintained automated test scripts after project completion. Trained and supported offshore QA team by providing hardware and test beds. 

- QA Technical Lead for gateway products:
-- QA test lead for team of 7. Built infrastructure to support new development and QA team. Sourced equipment for WiFi, VOIP, IPTV, and set top box. Install, configure and maintain test beds for automated regression tests, CMS/SMS servers for TR-069 interoperability, throughput and latency performance tests.  
-- Responsible for test sizings, schedules and execution plans
